subject: Vendor onboarding: proposed payment ladder & onboarding docs
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamvault.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + onboarding docs — StreamVault (payment ladder proposal)

Hi Evelyn / Karthik,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Attached are the W-9 and our standard onboarding workbook (StreamVault_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) to accelerate vendor activation. A few items we wanted to surface as we work through PO setup and payment terms: 

- Standard terms: Net 30, invoices to be routed to AP at ap@streamvault.com and reference your PO number.
- Early payment ladder (proposal): 2% if paid within 7 days, 1% if paid within 15 days. We can be flexible on thresholds during the first 90 days as you evaluate consumption.
- If Net45 is preferred on your side, we can accept Net45 with a 1% early-pay incentive for payment inside 15 days.

We can also complete any vendor-validation form you use (GL mapping, CAGE codes, tax forms). If you want, I can loop in our finance lead — otherwise I've attached the W-9 and onboarding workbook for you to drop into your vendor portal.

Attachments: SV_W9_2026.pdf (W-9), StreamVault_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (onboarding workbook)

Can we target completing paperwork and PO terms by Wednesday so we can start provisioning next week? Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call to finalize the PO language.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Vendor Ops | StreamVault, Inc.
liam.oconnor@streamvault.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamvault.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + onboarding docs — StreamVault (payment ladder proposal)

Thanks Liam — I reviewed the attachments and shared with our procurement and finance leads (cc'd). Quick notes / asks before we finalize PO language: 

- Aditya (AP) — can you confirm whether Redwood can run StreamVault as Net45 with an early-pay ladder (1% @ 15 days) or whether we should keep Net30 as standard for this vendor class?
- Karthik — procurement needs the completed onboarding workbook and preferred vendor category/GL suggestion so we can set up PO routing.
- Please confirm the exact remit instructions you expect on the invoice (e.g., ACH details vs. lockbox) and whether you require a PO on every invoice or only on large invoices > $5k.

We want to avoid creating multiple exception flows — if StreamVault can accept Net45 + 1% early-pay, that would likely map better to our billing cadence for new platform vendors. If not, we'll aim for Net30 and evaluate early pay as part of our supplier incentives program.

I'll pencil a 15-min sync for Wednesday afternoon; if you can send the completed workbook with GL mapping that will move the vendor activation forward.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Operations (acting as vendor intake lead)
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + onboarding docs — StreamVault (payment ladder proposal)

On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 10:03 AM evelyn_hart@redwood.com wrote:
> Thanks Liam — I reviewed the attachments and shared with our procurement and finance leads (cc'd). Quick notes / asks before we finalize PO language: 

I've reviewed SV_W9_2026.pdf and the onboarding workbook. Questions / proposals from AP: 

- Redwood policy default is Net 30 for new vendors but we routinely approve Net45 for platform & infra suppliers if they accept a small early-pay incentive.
- Proposed compromise for StreamVault: Net45 with 1.0% discount if invoices paid within 15 calendar days; escalate to Net30 if we see chargeback/quality issues in the first 60 days.
- Please provide ACH details and a primary AP contact. We will require a PO number on invoices > $2,500 for automatic routing; below that threshold we use our PO-less payments queue but will still route invoices to the same AP mailbox.

Attached: rdwd_invoice_routing_template_v2.xlsx — please fill GL code (cost center), remit instructions, and preferred invoice header (PO#/SOW reference).

Next steps: Karthik, vendor category + SOW needed to create the PO template. Liam, if StreamVault can sign off on Net45 + 1% @15 days and complete the routing template today, we can create the vendor record and issue the first PO by Thursday.

- Aditya
Director, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamvault.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + onboarding docs — StreamVault (payment ladder proposal)

On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 08:47 AM aditya_rao@redwood.com wrote:
> I've reviewed SV_W9_2026.pdf and the onboarding workbook. Questions / proposals from AP: 

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick review. We can confirm the following: 

- StreamVault accepts Net45 with a 1.0% early-pay discount for payments made within 15 calendar days.
- ACH details and the primary AP contact are in the attached onboarding workbook; we also attached a signed W-9 (SV_W9_2026.pdf).
- We agree to require a PO on invoices > $2,500. For smaller invoices we'll include the Redwood cost center and PO-less invoice reference as requested.

I uploaded the completed onboarding workbook and W-9 to your Drive (link above) and attached copies here for email routing. If you'd like, we can provide an initial invoice sample with the expected invoice header so you can validate the parsing in your pay cycle.

Next steps: 
- Karthik: please confirm vendor category and assign a GL code so we can be included in the first PO.
- Evelyn: happy to do a short call to finalize wording on the PO; I'm free Thursday 4–5pm PT.

Attachments: SV_W9_2026.pdf, StreamVault_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

Best,
Liam
Head of Vendor Ops | StreamVault, Inc.
liam.oconnor@streamvault.com
